lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five primary horizontal rows across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, forming a grid-like lattice where the high-luminance blobs act as vertex nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple symbiotic organisms (Echeneidae) are present: one large individual with high-luminance patterning is attached near the pectoral fin base, and at least four smaller individuals are visible in the ventral foreground.
